# moonlet-core fixtures

Each file is the real output of gh (or of git, for the `git-*` files), captured from the maintainer's own GitHub account and sanitised before commit (titles, logins, repository names, URLs and node ids replaced; issue bodies emptied). Edits beyond sanitising are listed.

| File | What | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gh-issue-list.json` | `gh issue list --json <GH_TASK_FIELDS>` (X44) | |
| `gh-projects.json` | `gh api graphql` with `projects_query(1)` (X50): the user's Projects and an organisation's (none) | Captured 2026-10-17 |
| `gh-project-items.json` | `gh api graphql` with `ITEMS_QUERY` for a user's Project (X50) | Captured 2026-10-17. Added: an assignee and a label on the first issue, and one pull request item (its `content` is empty, as gh gives for items that are not issues); the Project's `fields` and each item's `fieldValues`, in the shape gh gave on 2026-10-18 (fields of other kinds come as `{}`; none of the user's Projects had a number field), with two number fields, Estimate and Hours: #10 Estimate 3 and Hours 8, #11 Estimate 0.5, #12 Hours 5 |
| `gh-error-read-project-scope.json` | The projects query with a token without `read:project` | Captured 2026-10-17, unchanged |
| `gh-error-project-scope.json` | `updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue` with a token without `project` | Captured 2026-10-17, unchanged (a move to the item's own status, so nothing changed) |
| `gh-project-move.json` | `updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue` with the `project` scope (X50 moves) | Captured 2026-10-17, unchanged but for the item id (a move to the item's own status, so nothing changed) |
| `gh-auth-status.txt` | `gh auth status` with one account (X50: the scopes moves need) | Captured 2026-10-17; the login and the masked token replaced |
| `gh-project-clear.json` | `clearProjectV2ItemFieldValue` with the `project` scope (X50 No Status) | Captured 2026-10-17 on an issue with no Status already, so nothing changed; the item id replaced |
| `gh-project-add.json` | `addProjectV2ItemById` with the `project` scope (X52), on a sandbox Project | Captured 2026-10-18; the item id replaced; the issue was deleted after |
| `gh-issue-create.json`, `gh-assignees.json`, `gh-labels.json`, `gh-repo-permissions.json` (X52) | `gh api` on a sandbox repository: `repos/{r}/issues -X POST` (title, body, an assignee, the `bug` label), `repos/{r}/assignees`, `repos/{r}/labels`, `repos/{r}` | Captured 2026-10-18, sanitised: login `sam-rivera`, repo `acme/web`, every node id `*_e2eNNNN`, numeric ids replaced, avatars one placeholder; three of the default labels kept; the test issue was deleted after |
| `gh-error-issue-create.json` (X52) | `gh api repos/{r}/issues -X POST -f title=` (an empty title) | Captured 2026-10-18, unchanged; gh's stderr was `gh: Validation Failed (HTTP 422)` |
| `gh-pr-view.json`, `gh-pr-review-comments.json` (X54) | `gh pr view <n> --json author,body,reviews,comments` and `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/<n>/comments` on cli/cli | Captured 2026-10-19, sanitised: logins, bodies, paths, diff hunks, ids, node ids, commit ids and URLs replaced, repo `acme/web`, PR #214, avatars one placeholder, reactions zeroed. Edits: `author` from a separate `--json author` capture of the same PR; the reviews of one PR (a bot's with a body, an empty COMMENTED, an APPROVED) with a CHANGES_REQUESTED review added in their shape; two conversation comments from another PR's capture, the second given another author; the two line comments of the first PR (both outdated, so `line` is null; the second a reply) |
| `gh-repo-view.json`, `gh-repo-view-empty.json` (X59) | `gh repo view <r> --json name,nameWithOwner,description,isPrivate,defaultBranchRef,pushedAt,diskUsage` on a public repository and on an empty private one | Captured 2026-10-21, sanitised: repos `acme/storefront` and `acme/empty`, descriptions replaced (the empty one's emptied) |
| `gh-user-repos.json` (X59) | `gh api "user/repos?affiliation=owner,collaborator,organization_member&sort=pushed&per_page=100" --jq LIST_JQ` | Captured 2026-10-21; the first four of 100 kept, names and descriptions replaced (`acme/*`, `sam-rivera/store-locator`), `private` of the last set to false |
| `gh-auth-status-signed-out.txt` (X59) | `gh auth status --hostname github.com` with an empty `GH_CONFIG_DIR` | Captured 2026-10-21, unchanged (gh 2.102.0 prints it to stderr, exit 1) |
| `git-ls-remote-symref.txt` (X59) | `git ls-remote --symref https://github.com/<public repo>.git HEAD` | Captured 2026-10-21, unchanged |
| `git-clone-progress.txt` (X59) | The stderr of `gh repo clone <public repo> <dir> -- --progress`, `\r`s kept | Captured 2026-10-21 (gh 2.102.0, git over https); the folder name in "Cloning into" replaced with `storefront` |
| `gh-issue-comments.json` (X66) | `gh issue view <n> --json comments` on a sandbox repository | Captured 2026-10-23, sanitised: login `sam-rivera`, repo `acme/web`, node ids `IC_e2eNNNN`, comment URLs. Added in the captured shape: a minimized (OFF_TOPIC) comment by `jo-park` and a later one by `lee-moreno` |
